snippet.title: LabyrAInth Gameplay Trailer - Newer version
snippet.description:
Play now LABYRAINTH on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672600/LabyrAInth/
Wishlist the game and invite your friends to play against you!

Join our discord server here: https://discord.gg/Awp6WunubP. And be part of the community!

Also, we're on every socials:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/labyrainthpcvr/
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@labyrainthpcvr
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/LABYRAINTH/s/TvDA1GbgyG
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/labyrainth

LABYRAINTH is a fast paced maze-running roguelite fps set in a sci-fi world made of labyrinths. Fight your way out of a huge number of different dynamically created labyrinths. Your enemy is an omniscient AI who watches everything you do and sets traps and enemies to slow you down and kill you. Try to escape the mazes in time, and score your records on live global leaderboards!
Activate powers, find weapon components to attach to your main weapon, personalize your weapon and upgrade it between levels to increase the chances of winning.

LabyrAInth features 5 game modes:
Story: advance through a series of labyrinths and find the exit of all of them to beat the AI.
Infinite: compete against other players on online leaderboards on an infinite number of labyrinths of ever-increasing difficulty
Ranked: compete against other players on online leaderboards on a fixed number and configuration of labyrinths that changes every week.
Survival: fight hordes of aliens coming to kill you, hide, defend, upgrade your weapon and fight! How long will you survive in the labyrinth?
Creative: create your own labyrinth, make it big or make it small but super tough, fill it with enemies and traps and then play in it! Then share it with your friends!
LABYRAINTH will release on 31 of October 2025 for PC Windows and Mac platforms.
Future release for VR devices and mobile devices is already planned. 

Can you beat the Labyrinth?
